title: The Role Model
main_description: You always think before you post. By respecting privacy, context, and people's feelings, you've become someone others can trust both online and offline.
photo_trait_desc: You consistently choose frames that respect privacy and show the full story behind every moment.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions are kind, accurate, and never sacrifice someone's dignity for attention.

title: The Trusted Friend
main_description: People feel comfortable around your camera because they know you'll always treat them with respect and care.
photo_trait_desc: You naturally avoid exposing private or embarrassing moments.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions make people feel included instead of judged.

title: The Storyteller
main_description: You know how to turn everyday moments into meaningful stories without hurting anyone along the way.
photo_trait_desc: You focus on what truly matters instead of distractions.
caption_trait_desc: Your words help others understand the moment without twisting its meaning.

title: The Thoughtful Student
main_description: You usually pause before posting and consider how your content might affect others.
photo_trait_desc: Most of your photos protect context and privacy.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions are usually thoughtful and respectful.

title: The Supporter
main_description: Your posts lift people up more often than they bring them down, making your feed a positive place to be.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions focus on appreciation rather than criticism.

title: The Observer
main_description: You rarely cause problems online, but sometimes you're so cautious that you miss opportunities to tell meaningful stories.
photo_trait_desc: You avoid risky photos and respect boundaries.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions stay safe, even if they aren't always memorable.

title: The Photographer
main_description: You're great at capturing beautiful photos, but sometimes aesthetics matter more than the people in them. Try to make the people feel like the heart of the story!
photo_trait_desc: You naturally look for eye-catching shots.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions fit the photo, but don't always consider their impact.

title: The Trend Chaser
main_description: You love following what’s popular and keeping your content up to date, but sometimes you get caught up in trends without thinking about the impact of your posts.
photo_trait_desc: You consistently choose the most eye-catching parts of a photo to stay relevant, but sometimes you overlook the context behind what you share.
caption_trait_desc: You consistently use trendy and attention-grabbing captions, but sometimes prioritize engagement over the meaning and impact of your words.

title: The Attention Seeker
main_description: Likes and reactions have started to matter more than the people in your photos.
photo_trait_desc: You often frame moments to grab attention instead of showing the whole picture.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions are written to get reactions, even if they're unfair.

title: The Clickbaiter
main_description: You know exactly how to make people stop scrolling, but not always for the right reasons.
photo_trait_desc: You focus on details that can easily be misunderstood.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions exaggerate or distort the real story to attract attention.

title: The Gossiper
main_description: Without realizing it, your posts often spread assumptions instead of facts.
photo_trait_desc: You capture moments that are easy to misinterpret.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions often jump to conclusions without knowing the full story.

title: The Oversharer
main_description: You share almost everything, forgetting that not every moment or piece of information belongs online.
photo_trait_desc: You often include personal details that should stay private.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions reveal more than they should.

title: The Paparazzi
main_description: No moment seems off-limits to you, even when others clearly don't want to be photographed.
photo_trait_desc: You prioritize getting the shot over respecting people's comfort.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions make private moments even more public.

title: The Drama Queen
main_description: Your feed is filled with conflict, embarrassment, and controversy because those moments get the most attention.
photo_trait_desc: You naturally focus on conflict instead of the bigger picture.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions add fuel to situations that don't need it.

title: The Chaos
main_description: Your posts frequently hurt people, spread negativity, or create unnecessary problems. Going viral has become more important than doing what's right.
photo_trait_desc: You intentionally highlight moments that embarrass or expose others.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions encourage ridicule, conflict, or misinformation.

title: The Fool
main_description: You chase attention without thinking about the consequences. By ignoring privacy, context, and respect, you've lost the trust of the people around you.
photo_trait_desc: You consistently frame moments in misleading or harmful ways, ignoring how they affect others.
caption_trait_desc: Your captions mock, assume, or expose people for attention, no matter the consequences.
